thread:
rachel: acme POC saw mixed 401/403 after swapping a token during onboarding. can we quickly triage?

dan: what do the errors say?

rachel: they pasted this: 

```\ncurl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_personal_14X\" -H \"X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp\" https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{\"error\":\"invalid_token\",\"message\":\"token_org_mismatch: token org=dev-labs, req org=acme-corp\"}
```

priya: Looks like a personal token from another org. Also saw a separate 403 on stream calls complaining about missing scope `inference:stream`.

infra-bot: metrics: acme-poc - token_errors=15 (10m), avg_rps=7.0, 95p_latency=220ms.

dan: root causes: 1) token bound to wrong org; 2) token missing required streaming scope.

rachel: remediation I suggested to customer: 1) generate an org-scoped service token in the Acme console with scopes `inference:invoke,inference:stream` and bind to project if using project headers. 2) rotate into app env and restart. 3) for programmatic rotation use `rdwctl tokens create --org acme-corp --project acme-stream --scopes inference:invoke,inference:stream`.

priya: security blurb to send: "Tokens issued by Redwood include creator, issuance time, scopes, org/project binding, and last-used timestamps in audit logs. Tokens can be revoked via console/API; short-lived SSO tokens and KMS-backed rotation are available for stricter controls."

rachel: customer rotated to an org token and confirms both REST + stream calls are successful now.

dan: action items: dan -> send repro and rdwctl snippet to their engineer; priya -> post security blurb to their security contact; rachel -> update CRM and close POC auth ticket.

infra-bot: monitoring: token_errors cleared (last 10m).

rachel: thanks team, closing swarm.
